title: Running the Show
subtitle: Command phase, secondaries, stratagems & army rules

bullets: Every battle round starts with the [b]Command phase[/b]: +1 CP, then your secondary missions.
The mission review shows what you're scoring for — [b]Discard[/b] one for a CP, or [b]Replace[/b] it for a CP.
Army rules live in the command panel — [b]CALL DA WAAAGH![/b] is once per battle.
[b][S] Stratagems[/b] spends CP any time it's legal; [b]Missions[/b] and [b]Roster[/b] show scoring and your army.
That's the lot — every phase, every button. Now go fight a real battle.
bullets_orky: Every battle round starts wiv da [b]Command phase[/b]: +1 CP, den yer secondary missions.

Army rules live in da command panel — [b]CALL DA WAAAGH![/b] is once per battle.
[b][S] Stratagems[/b] spends CP any time it's legal; [b]Missions[/b] an' [b]Roster[/b] show scorin' an' yer army.
Dat's da lot — every phase, every button. Now go krump somefin' for real.
